review_note: Read the test and helpers line by line. For each of beta, beta_binomial, cumulative_logit, hurdle NB2 and ZIP the file fits (1 | id) with sd(id) ~ w and (0 + x | id) with sd(id, coef = 'x') ~ w, and compares logLik with a base-R dense Laplace at the fitted parameters (fixed effects, sigma, hu or zi, cutpoints from fit$ordinal), with hand densities and a five-point stencil for eta-derivatives. Hand densities are checked in b31no_check_densities against references sharing no code (numerical integration of binomial x beta mixture, dnbinom-based truncation and sum to one over 0:4000, dpois-based ZIP and sum to one, integral of dlogis between cutpoints, dbeta); that check executes in the NB2 file of the same batch, so the iid file relies on it being run with the group. Row mapping verified: the hurdle_nbinom2 row is truncated_nbinom2() with sigma ~ 1, hu ~ 1 (docs family-endpoints.tsv and family-links.tsv name exactly this route, and the oracle takes hu = P(0) from coef(fit, 'hu') through plogis, agreeing to 1e-10), and zi_poisson is stats::poisson() with zi ~ 1 (same ledger mapping, agreement ~1e-8). Selectors are non-palindromic permutation grids; only reversed-SD and flipped-selector bugs are emulated (iid has no kernel), each asserted > 0.1, observed min gaps 1.4 to 150 vs 1e-4. Hashes recompute; log 10 blocks, 72 expectations, 0 failures, 0 skips, 0 warnings; Totoro rerun reproduced 10/72/0/0/0. All 10 linked rows are supported. Does NOT establish: calibration, coverage, recovery, Julia parity, ZeroOneBeta, hu or zi regression formulas beyond ~1, ordinal models with more than 4 categories, hand-density correctness beyond the stated references, or behaviour at more than one seed per route.
